output.why: The specification, P&ID, and datasheet all require two (1W+1S) vertical sump type Sludge Sump Transfer Pumps mounted over the underground RCC sludge sump (E14, two compartments of 6.25 m3 each). Adding a third pump requires reviewing the physical layout and civil design of the RCC sludge sump (in BHEL's civil scope) as well as MCC feeder availability to ensure the third vertical pump can be accommodated.
